decisive_items: hard swelling over the right maxilla
extensive, well-demarcated, dense amorphous irregular calcified lesion
response.rationale: Cemento-ossifying fibroma is more likely due to the presence of a hard swelling and a well-demarcated calcified lesion

rejected.why: Odontogenic keratocyst is less likely as it typically does not present with a hard swelling or a well-demarcated calcified lesion
